summary: Replaced repeated index sorting with first-payload lookup and requested-ID iteration, excluding unrequested and duplicate entities.
Added template-controller regressions for missing/extra results, duplicate payloads and preserved empty-page metadata.
Added nine source-based guide chapters with focused verification evidence.
limits: Controller tests use service and mapper substitutes; they do not certify production search, database or browser authorization behavior.
Focused unit verification does not imply the complete upstream Umbraco test suite passed.

checks.command: Recorded test runs and build/type checks
